pipelines.P: raw Mg/Ag/Sb/additive lots → Ar mill batch → P powder → Sb/P/Sb blank → indexed cut legs
pipelines.N: raw Mg/In/Sb/Bi/Te lots → Ar mill batch → N powder → steel-interface blank → cut N legs; source cut relation unknown
pipelines.B: raw Bi/Sb/Te lots → quartz melt batch → ingot → mill powder → bare B blank → perpendicular-indexed legs
pipelines.SEG: P_leg + B_leg + GaIn application event → Sb/P/Sb/GaIn/B specimen
pipelines.PAIR: P1+N1+P2+N2+AlN+Cu connection events → new two-pair module

rules: Full composition never overwritten by shorthand
Every cut child consumes an explicit parent interval/portion; unknown real yield remains unknown
P1/P2 and N1/N2 have different IDs; separate portions can share a batch but not occupy four physical locations as one object
Pressing axis is established at die and travels with blank/leg; P/B cutting labels cannot swap; N direction is not invented as source
Same-object thermal/current scans retain object ID; each condition/point produces new record ID, not a fresh independent sample
Separate 6.7/8.8 mm controls and contact/efficiency episode objects are task-authored allocation, not claimed author chronology
Contact-probed or measured specimens retain their history; unknown damage does not reset to pristine
Failed/aborted events immutable; remeasure produces a linked new run
No resynthesis from a plot, no phantom output without loaded inputs
Unused/remainder/waste quantities balanced symbolically; real grams/moles not fabricated

quantity_basis.source: batch masses, yields and replicate counts unreported
quantity_basis.task: manifest-issued symbolic portions and count/parent constraints
quantity_basis.not_allowed: claim a real chemical mass balance without data
